review.assessment:
## Change Summary
The diff replaces space-only splitting with a character-by-character parser that collects runs of alphanumeric characters into lowercase strings, correctly treating any non-alphanumeric codepoint as a delimiter. It then materializes the frequency map into a vector and sorts it by descending count followed by ascending alphabetical order for ties. This directly satisfies the case-insensitivity, robust delimiting, and sorting requirements.

## Findings
None found. The implementation correctly handles consecutive delimiters, trailing punctuation, and empty input without allocation overhead, compiles cleanly, and passes the provided test suite.
